claim: Binsky Home — 281 Centennial Ave, Suite C, Piscataway (HVAC/plumbing/electrical)
problem: Wrong town/address. The company's own contact page lists its addresses as 22 Worlds Fair Drive, Suite E, Somerset NJ 08873 and 2000 Cabot Blvd W, Langhorne PA — no Piscataway location. 281 Centennial Ave appears to belong to Binsky & Snyder, the commercial mechanical arm, not the residential 'Binsky Home' entity in this list.
fix: Either re-attribute the entry to Binsky & Snyder (commercial mechanical, Piscataway) or drop it; if kept, change address to Somerset and re-test against the zone's base-in-town rule.

claim: Olympus Construction, LLC. — 54 Powers St, Piscataway, phone (732) 418-7111
problem: Wrong town. 54 Powers St is in New Brunswick, NJ 08901 (BBB profile is filed under New Brunswick, and Olympus' own site is a New Jersey-wide construction company with no Piscataway address).
fix: Remove from the Piscataway zone or move to the New Brunswick zone.

claim: Aura Home Exteriors — 180 Talmadge Rd, Suite 447, Piscataway

claim: Greysi and Sons Solutions — general contractor, Piscataway

claim: Katamount Construction Company — 495 Union Ave, Suite 2C, Piscataway
problem: Address unverified. katamountnj.com/contact shows no address at all, and directories (GAF contractor record, company site) place the firm in Middlesex rather than at 495 Union Ave. Only a Google Maps result asserted the Piscataway suite.
fix: Verify 495 Union Ave directly (call/city permit record) or move the entry to the Middlesex zone; keep phone (908) 373-1244, which is confirmed.

problem: Two entries look like branches of larger multi-location brands rather than Piscataway independents: 'Precision Painting Plus of Edison' (Precision Painting Plus runs at least six NJ offices, including a Piscataway office at 30 Knightsbridge Rd, and markets under one brand) and 'Sciens Building Solutions / Absolute Protective Systems' (its own page states it is 'part of the Sciens Building Solutions network', a multi-state fire/security platform). Both plausibly breach the chains/franchises exclusion.
fix: Confirm ownership (franchise/company-owned/corporate branch) and drop both if they are brand branches; keep Absolute Protective Systems only if it is being targeted as the local operating brand with local decision-making.

claim: Precision Painting Plus of Edison — 'Angi profile with 852 reviews'
problem: Review volume/scale is consistent with a multi-crew regional brand, not the owner-operator profile the zone is being built for; the entry was already self-flagged 'may be a franchise-style operation'.
fix: Treat as out-of-scope unless triage specifically wants multi-location brands; do not spend verification time on it before that decision.
